$comment: Single source of repo-specific knowledge for the hooks in .claude/hooks (generic, byte-identical across doctiling repos; checked by doctiling-workspace scripts/harness-drift.sh). Docs: docs/agent-harness.md.

protectedPaths.reason: .env files are never edited by the agent (this repo is public: nothing secret belongs here at all).
package-lock.json is regenerated with `npx -y npm@10.8.2 install`, never edited by hand.
git history is not edited file by file.

bashRules.reason: Skipping the verification hooks is forbidden. If the gate is in the way, fix the gate.
`git push --force` needs an explicit request from the human.
`git reset --hard` destroys work: needs an explicit request from the human.
`git add .` sweeps local state. Stage specific files.
